description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of a log/show command with tab expansion options. It defines functions to set up test scenarios and compare expected versus actual output, specifically focusing on expanding tabs to spaces in command output.

methods.name: count_expand
methods.description: Calculates expected spaces and tabs, builds expected output, and compares it with actual command output.

methods.name: test_expand
methods.description: Sets up and runs multiple test cases for different formatting options, verifying tab expansion behavior.
